result.title: Compositional Concepts Erasing: Disentangling Object-Style via Domain Manifold Unlearning
result.summary: Diffusion models pose significant risks regarding the generation of illicit content and copyright violations. This has catalyzed the development of machine unlearning to erase harmful concepts or copyrighted styles from a model's generative repertoire without compromising its general performance. However, previous unlearning approaches on diffusion models have largely focused on either object-level or style-level removal and failed to address the challenge of object-style combination unlearning. At the same time, multiple unlearning requests often lead to catastrophic forgetting. To address these challenges, we propose Domain Manifold Unlearning (DMU), which uses an EMA-updated feature proxy extracted from intermediate diffusion features to represent the retained target-object direction. As a lightweight estimating representation of an object, DMU enables selective unlearning of domain-specific components in a specific object while preserving other semantic representations, thereby significantly enhancing robustness in multiple combination unlearning scenarios. Extensive experiments show that DMU significantly mitigates catastrophic forgetting, outperforming state-of-the-art methods of batch unlearning and sequential unlearning.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Domain Manifold Unlearning（DMU），用从扩散模型中间特征中提取并经 EMA 更新的特征代理表示目标物体方向，从而在抹除「物体-风格」组合概念时只移除特定域成分、保留其他语义，缓解批量与顺序遗忘中的灾难性遗忘。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「由中间特征构造概念方向、只选择性抹除某个子空间而保留其余语义」的解耦与状态编辑思路，可能为 LVR 中分离和操控 latent 状态里的视觉证据与风格／先验成分提供方法线索，可供核查；但论文本身面向图像生成的遗忘任务，不直接研究多模态推理。
